scientific_integrity: Established cube and cross-polytope special cases are credited; unrestricted proof and numerical tests are distinguished; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to two orthogonal centered unit cubes of dimensions at least two; not a general free-sum calculus. Full historical priority is not established. Finite quadratic-program checks do not prove the unbounded theorem.
title: Exact facial-distance spectrum and extremal-face rigidity of orthogonal cubical joins
